prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1204; do not mention it.)
text: Driver 1 was stopped in the left lane of a two-lane roadway in League City, Texas, waiting for traffic ahead to clear. Driver 2 was traveling behind Driver 1 and did not stop in time, striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Both vehicles sustained visible rear-end damage. Driver 2 stated that a momentary distraction caused the impact and admitted to following too closely. Driver 1 was the only occupant of the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and said it began shortly after the collision. A passenger in Driver 2's vehicle was uninjured and declined medical attention. Both drivers were able to move their vehicles to the shoulder without assistance. Responding officers observed no signs of impairment in either driver. Emergency medical services evaluated Driver 1 at the scene, and Driver 1 was transported to a local hospital for further examination. Photographs of the vehicles and roadway were taken and are attached to this report.
